sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a 9-billion-parameter open-weights multimodal model from Alibaba's Qwen family, supporting both text and image inputs. The model features a unified vision-language architecture with early fusion of multimodal tokens, enabling reasoning across text and images in a single context. It is available under the Apache 2.0 license and released on March 10, 2026.
